name: Sources: Where the Astrology Texts and Pictures Live
description:
# Sources: where the astrology texts and pictures live, and their rights

For each book this library's voices quote (Ptolemy, Lilly, Manilius, the Mesopotamian omens, the Bṛhat Jātaka, Alan Leo, Raphael, Proctor, Bailey, Tarnas) and the picture sets it shows: where the scans are, how good they are, and **what their rights allow**, in the holder's own words where they could be read. Each source also says plainly who holds the rights and what we may and may not do.

**Three ways in.** Selections by **book**, by **holder** and by **rights** (free for any use · open licence · unclear · in copyright). A source can sit in several.

**Links only.** This grammar copies no text or picture.

**Worth knowing.** The Lilly grammar links an Internet Archive upload that its uploader marked CC BY-NC 3.0; the Wellcome Library's scan of the 1647 edition carries the Public Domain Mark and is the better copy to cite.

**Not legal advice.** Checked 2026-10-20 (archive.org metadata read for every scan). Hand-edited.

metadata.rights_label: Free for any use, as the holder states (public domain, CC0, PD mark, or no restriction)

sections.What it holds: The 1822 English translation the Tetrabiblos grammar quotes.

nodes.name: Tetrabiblos (Ashmand) on Project Gutenberg and sacred-texts

metadata.rights_label: Free for any use, as the holder states (public domain, CC0, PD mark, or no restriction)

sections.Property rights: Free; check doubtful words against the 1822 scan.
sections.What it holds: The same translation, typed; the grammar links sacred-texts chapter pages (https://sacred-texts.com/astro/ptb/).
sections.Rights as published: Gutenberg's header: "This eBook is for the use of anyone anywhere in the United States and most other parts of the world at no cost and with almost no restrictions whatsoever."

nodes.name: Lilly, Christian Astrology (1647): the Wellcome copy

metadata.holder: Internet Archive (Wellcome Library copy, item b30338724)
metadata.rights_label: Free for any use, as the holder states (public domain, CC0, PD mark, or no restriction)

sections.Property rights: Public Domain Mark from the Wellcome: free for any use. The best copy to cite.
sections.Holder: Internet Archive (Wellcome Library copy, item b30338724)
sections.What it holds: The 1647 first edition, the three books.
sections.Rights as published: Item rights: "This work is available under the Creative Commons, Public Domain Mark".

nodes.name: Christian Astrology on Internet Archive (an uploader's copy)

metadata.rights_label: No rights statement found, or the uploader's claim is doubtful

sections.Property rights: A 1647 text can't carry a new NC licence, but the uploader's scan or retyping may: prefer the Wellcome copy (Public Domain Mark) for links and quotes.
sections.What it holds: A copy the Lilly grammar links 20 times; the item names no source edition.
sections.Rights as published: Item licence: Creative Commons BY-NC 3.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/3.0/), set by the uploader.

metadata.rights_label: Free for any use, as the holder states (public domain, CC0, PD mark, or no restriction)

sections.Property rights: Free for any use in the US and EU.

sections.Rights as published: Item metadata carries no rights statement. Published 1928 (US public domain since 2024); Langdon d. 1937, Fotheringham d. 1936 (UK/EU free since 2008).

nodes.name: Alan Leo, Astrology for All (1899) and How to Judge a Nativity (1928 edition)

metadata.holder: Internet Archive (Harvard; Harold B. Lee Library copies)
metadata.rights_label: Free for any use, as the holder states (public domain, CC0, PD mark, or no restriction)

sections.Property rights: Free for any use; the 1928 printing is US public domain since 2024.
sections.Holder: Internet Archive (Harvard; Harold B. Lee Library copies)
sections.What it holds: The Theosophical revival's textbooks, quoted by the Alan Leo grammar. Also https://archive.org/details/howtojudgenativi00leoa.
sections.Rights as published: astrologyforall00leogoog: possible-copyright-status "NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT"; howtojudgenativi00leoa: no statement (a 1928 printing; Leo d. 1917).

metadata.rights_label: In copyright: link and cite only

sections.Rights as published: In copyright (Lucis Trust); its online terms were not re-read for this entry.
